name: pyrosim-fds-workflows
description: PyroSim and FDS simulation workflow tools for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the local PyroSim/FDS MCP tools for safe case inspection, preflight, approval-gated simulation runs, status polling, and cancellation.
